g.text: Reference only - no wiring. X marks = not connected on purpose.

g.text: Pin names copied from the official v2 pinout image

g.desc: Pin names copied from the official v2 pinout image

g.text: Pin numbers 1-26 are ours (the image has none): left column 1-13 top to bottom

g.desc: Pin numbers 1-26 are ours (the image has none): left column 1-13 top to bottom

g.text: (USB-C end at the top), right column 14-26 bottom to top (BATTERY+ top = 26, 25).

g.desc: (USB-C end at the top), right column 14-26 bottom to top (BATTERY+ top = 26, 25).

g.text: Arduino labels on the image: D1=P0.06 D0=P0.08 D2=P0.17 D3=P0.20 D4=P0.22 D5=P0.24

g.text: Image legend: when P0.13 is set low, power to the 3.3V pin is cut off (external VCC cutoff).

g.text: Image note: bridging the BOOST jumper raises the charge rate from 100 mA to 500 mA.
